name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited,  incorporated  in  1993 ,  is  a  Electronic  Manufacturing  Services  (EMS)  company  with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras  (CCTVs), and mobile  phones. It also  undertakes reverse logistics operations.  Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India. [1]

business.what: Dixon Technologies is an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company. It makes products such as mobile phones, IT hardware, telecom gear, appliances, TVs, refrigerators and lighting for brands and ODM customers, earning contract manufacturing revenue, with some work tied to government incentive schemes.

ledger.promise: Revenue and EBITDA to grow in H1 FY27 despite memory-price headwinds
ledger.quote: No, we still have growth. We are still working on the numbers because there is some level of uncertainty, but we feel that there will be growth in spite of these challenges.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue 37,342 vs 27,691 in H1 FY26 (+34.9%). EBITDA 1,060 vs 1,043 (+1.6%), so EBITDA grew only barely.

ledger.promise: FY27 group revenue of about 56,000 crore, excluding Vivo and with flat mobile volumes
ledger.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue 37,342, which is 67% of the target. H2 needs 18,658, below the 21,183 reported in H2 FY26.

ledger.promise: Margin expansion from components in FY28; 40-50 bps above last year once the component play is fully running
ledger.quote: '27 -'28, we are absolutely confident that there should be a decent margin expansion largely on account of component play.
ledger.actual: FY26 EBITDA margin 3.83%; H1 FY27 2.84% (Q2 2.7%). Q1 FY27 call: no improvement this year, improvement expected FY28.

ledger.promise: Mobile phone business EBITDA margin of 2.8% to 3.2% over the next 12 months
ledger.quote: We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.
ledger.actual: No segment margin reported. Consolidated EBITDA margin fell from 3.9% (Q3 FY26) to 2.7% (Q2 FY27).

ledger.promise: Mobile export revenue of 5,500-6,000 crore in FY26, held as the FY27 run rate
ledger.quote: We feel we should be closing at almost INR5,500 crores, INR6,000 crores in the current fiscal. We feel that this is going to be the run rate in the forthcoming fiscal.
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26 call guided FY27 exports to about 4,000 crore. Q2 FY27 call: 3.5-4m export units, with anchor exports ramping only from Q4.

ledger.promise: High double-digit quarter-on-quarter smartphone volume growth in Q1 FY27
ledger.quote: we expect a high -double- digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call reported a mobile volume decline, blamed on a 10-12% contraction in the smartphone market.

ledger.promise: PN3 approval for the Vivo JV 'soon', followed by JV revenue
ledger.quote: We remain confident of getting the PN3 approval for our Vivo JV soon.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call: JV revenue from Q3 FY27. Q2 FY27 call: production now targeted from Q4 FY27, with significant volumes in FY28.

ledger.promise: Noida 1 million sq ft facility: construction done by Q1 FY27, mass production by Q2 FY27
ledger.quote: Construction of a 1 million square feet facility in Noida ... is expected to be completed by Q1 of financial year '26-'27 and mass production to start by Q2 of '26-'27.
ledger.actual: Reaffirmed for Q2 on the Q4 FY26 call, then moved to Q3 FY27 on the Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 calls.

ledger.promise: Display module JV (HKC) phase 1: trials by Q2 FY27 (also stated as trials and commercial production by June-July 2026)
ledger.quote: trial should commence by Q2 of next fiscal.
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26: trials Q3, mass production end Q3/early Q4. Q2 FY27: auto/notebook trials Q3, mobile trials Q4, mass production FY28.

ledger.promise: Inventec JV SSD and memory module mass production from Q2 FY27
ledger.quote: mass production of SSD and memory modules is planned to begin in Q2 of '26 -'27
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call: SSD from Q3 and JV operational Q4. Q2 FY27 call: JV trial in Q3, operational at end Q3 or in Q4.

ledger.promise: IT hardware revenue of 3,500-4,000 crore in FY27
ledger.quote: We feel that for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.
ledger.actual: Raised to 3x FY26 on the Q4 FY26 call, then to 6,000-6,500 crore on 1.3-1.4m units on the Q2 FY27 call. No segment revenue reported.

ledger.quote: So we will do a capex of closer to INR1,100 crores, INR1,150-odd crores.
ledger.actual: FY26 cash used in investing was 1,138 crore, which is inside the guided range (used as a proxy for capex).

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Management has delivered on the headline numbers it can control in the short term: H1 FY27 revenue grew 34.9%, FY27 revenue is tracking ahead of the 56,000 crore target, FY26 capex landed in the guided range, and IT hardware guidance has been raised twice. Against that, almost every commissioning date (Vivo JV, display JV, Noida, Inventec/SSD, Longcheer) has slipped by one to two quarters, the mobile export target was cut, the Q1 FY27 volume growth call was missed, and margins have fallen rather than expanded.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Backward integration into components will expand margins, and mobile margins can hold at 2.8-3.2%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated EBITDA margin was 3.8-3.9% in every quarter of FY26, then fell to 3.0% in Q1 FY27 and 2.7% in Q2 FY27. H1 FY27 EBITDA rose 1.6% while revenue rose 34.9%.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Strong growth continues despite a weak smartphone market, with a 56,000 crore target for FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2 FY27 revenue was 21,794, up 46.7% on Q2 FY26 (14,855). H1 FY27 revenue was 37,342, two-thirds of the FY27 target.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management explains profitability through operating drivers: PLI ending, memory prices and the timing of the component ramp.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Reported profit has repeatedly exceeded operating profit. Q1 FY27 PBT was 869 on EBITDA of 463, and Q2 FY26 PBT was 924 on EBITDA of 561. TTM PAT of 1,747 equals 93% of TTM EBITDA (1,883). These materials do not say where the non-operating gains come from.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Capex will be funded from internal accruals, with free cash flow next year.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 operating cash flow of 1,782 covered investing outflow of 1,138, and the cash conversion cycle was -7 days. But borrowings rose from 489 (FY24) to 994 (FY26) and 1,236 (FY27), and capital WIP rose from 257 to 885.

bull.point: Revenue delivery is ahead of the full-year target.
bull.evidence: H1 FY27 revenue of 37,342 is 67% of the 56,000 crore FY27 target. Q2 FY27 revenue of 21,794 was the highest quarter in the data, up 46.7% YoY.
bull.source: reported numbers; Q4 FY26 call p15

bull.point: IT hardware guidance has gone up at each call.
bull.evidence: FY27 IT hardware revenue guidance moved from 3,500-4,000 crore (Q3 FY26) to 3x FY26 (Q4 FY26) to 6,000-6,500 crore on 1.3-1.4m units (Q2 FY27).

bull.point: Operating cash flow covers capex, and working capital is negative.
bull.evidence: FY26 operating cash flow of 1,782 exceeded investing outflow of 1,138. The cash conversion cycle was -7 days in FY26. FY26 capex came in at 1,138 against guidance of 1,100-1,150.
bull.source: reported numbers; Q3 FY26 call p17

bear.point: Margins are falling while revenue grows, and management now expects no improvement this year.
bear.evidence: EBITDA margin was 2.7% in Q2 FY27 vs 3.8% in Q2 FY26. H1 EBITDA rose 1.6% on 34.9% revenue growth. Management said: 'we are not expecting a margin improvement from here onwards'.
bear.source: reported numbers; Q1 FY27 call p18

bear.point: The projects meant to lift margins keep slipping.
bear.evidence: Display trials moved from Q1/Q2 FY27 to Q3/Q4, with mass production now in FY28. Vivo JV production moved from 'soon' to Q3 and then Q4. Noida moved from Q2 to Q3. Inventec SSD moved from Q2 to Q3/Q4.

bear.point: Mobile volume and export targets have been cut or missed.
bear.evidence: The FY27 mobile export run rate of 5,500-6,000 crore was cut to about 4,000 crore. Q1 FY27 high double-digit QoQ volume growth became a decline. FY27 volume ex-Vivo is now 33-34m, roughly flat on last year.
bear.source: Q4 FY26 call p12; Q1 FY27 call p4
